title: PF400 re-author route (grok-4.7, 2026-11-05)
description: Routing for gh.ad-sdl/pf400_module_ros under the user's decision of 2026-11-05 (Grok authors, Codex reviews). The card's ros/RosDriver route is replaced by a direct Driver over pf400_driver.pf400_driver.tcp_driver:PF400. The status-port halt and the single-client status-port precondition are in the justification, which the registry stores as the card's decision evidence. Modes and capability classes are left to the scan: an arm stays hardware, and a joint-position class would publish an R1 floor.

overrides.justification: Re-author (grok-4.7): status-port halt (Cmd.gpl:1840) because the robot port blocks during motion (Main.gpl:203-209). The status port serves one client (Main.gpl:88-90); a busy or unreachable port fails the stop.
